SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION NOV-03-2004, CONTINUED BY COURT TO MAY-11-2005 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506 DEFT WAIVES NO POS. SETTLEMENT BETWEEN THE PARTIES FOR A TOTAL AMT OF $5025.50. CONT'D FOR PROGRESS REPORT. IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE CONT'D FOR 6 MONTH INTERVALS UNTIL PAID OFF AT WHICH TIME THE CASE
